title: AI Engineer
description:
We are hiring an AI Engineer to build the matching and search systems behind our hiring
marketplace. The work is embeddings and retrieval over resumes and vacancies, LLM features in production
(structured extraction, RAG), and the evaluation harness that tells us whether any of it works. You would
own features end to end: pipeline, service, deployment, monitoring.

We are flexible on where in the EU you sit, and we can be flexible on seniority for the right person, but
we are not able to sponsor visas and this is a full-time role.

must.criterion: Hands-on with embeddings, vector search, RAG or LLM APIs in production
Has shipped and operated something themselves, not only prototyped

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
description:
Senior backend engineer for the core marketplace services: applications, messaging, billing
and the public API. Python and Postgres, on AWS.

This one is genuinely on-site three days a week, so the person has to already live in the Randstad:
Amsterdam, Utrecht, Rotterdam or Eindhoven. We have tried remote for this team and it did not work. No
sponsorship, full-time, and we need someone senior: five years minimum, most of it in Python.

must.criterion: Strong relational database and SQL skills
Production AWS, containers, infrastructure as code
Testing discipline and code review habits

title: ML Platform Engineer (MLOps)
description:
Own the platform our models and LLM features run on: training and deployment pipelines,
model registry, rollout strategy, drift and cost monitoring.

The team is in Stockholm and we want this person in the Nordics for timezone and travel reasons, so
Sweden, Denmark, Finland or Norway. Four years minimum in platform, infrastructure or MLOps work. Full-time, no
sponsorship.

must.criterion: Operating ML or LLM workloads in production

nice.criterion: SageMaker, Vertex AI or Azure ML
Feature stores or vector database operations

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data engineer for the pipelines feeding analytics, matching and customer reporting.

The hiring manager has been specific. They want someone who has run dbt AND Flink AND Snowflake in
production, has at least eight years in data engineering, and is a native Dutch speaker because they will
sit with the Dutch commercial team daily. Anywhere in the EU, full-time, no sponsorship.

(This is the brief as written. Treat it as the brief.)
